   221→                                                          leaveHandle: leaveHandle,

   223→                                                          mediaProvider: userSession.mediaProvider)
   224→            leaveSpaceViewModel.actions.sink { [weak self] action in
   225→                guard let self else { return }
   226→                switch action {
   227→                case .didCancel:

   229→                case .presentRolesAndPermissions:

   248→    private func setupRoomSubscription() {

   250→            .receive(on: DispatchQueue.main)

   253→            }
   254→            .store(in: &cancellables)
   255→        
   256→        roomProxy.knockRequestsStatePublisher
   257→            .map { requestsState in

   260→                }
   261→                return requests.count
   262→            }
   263→            .removeDuplicates()
   264→            .throttle(for: .milliseconds(100), scheduler: DispatchQueue.main, latest: true)
